subscription.cancelBody: The subscription runs until {{date}} and then ends. Nothing more is charged. Until then you can take the cancellation back.
subscription.cancelBodyNoDate: The subscription runs to the end of the paid period and then ends. Nothing more is charged.
subscription.contact.title: Billing details
subscription.contact.hint: Hubra's invoices go to this email and address. Changes apply in Stripe at once.
subscription.contact.hintDefault: Suggested from the finance email and the address on your QR bills. Save them so Hubra's invoices go to the club.
subscription.endsOn: The subscription is cancelled and ends on {{date}}.
subscription.hint: What the club pays for Hubra. Payment is through Stripe, for example by card; you manage the card and invoices in Stripe's customer portal.
subscription.hintOff: What the club pays for Hubra. Paying online is not set up yet; Hubra will get in touch.
subscription.stripeFailed: Stripe cannot be reached right now
subscription.thanks: Thank you! The club's Hubra subscription is running.
subscription.title: Hubra subscription
subscription.trialPay: You can add a payment method now. Nothing is charged before the trial ends.
subscription.trouble: The last payment did not go through. Please check the card or account under “Manage payment”, Stripe then tries again.
subscription.plansHint: A change applies at once. The difference for the rest of the month is added pro rata to the next invoice.
subscription.switchBody: The new plan applies at once. The difference for the rest of the month is added pro rata to the next invoice.
subscription.addonsHint: Modules with their own price. Adding one switches the module on; the amount for the rest of the month is added pro rata to the next invoice.
subscription.addonOnBody: {{price}}. The module is switched on. The amount for the rest of this month is added pro rata to the next invoice.
subscription.addonOffBody: The module is switched off; its data stays. The rest of the month is credited pro rata on the next invoice.
subscription.holdersHint: Only members with a licence see and use the module. {{used}} of {{max}} assigned.
subscription.holdersFull: All licences are assigned. For more members, raise the number of licences.
subscription.notBilled: Your club is not being billed at the moment.
subscription.addonOffBodyFree: The module is switched off; its data stays.
subscription.addonsHintFree: Modules with their own price. Adding one switches the module on. {{free}}
subscription.sponsoredStripeEnds: So your payment via Stripe ends on {{date}}; nothing is charged after that.
